description: Source file containing utility functions and class implementations for disk cache testing in Chromium, including key generation, buffer filling, cache creation/deletion, integrity checks, and callback handling.

classes.name: TestBackendResultCompletionCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling backend result completion.

classes.name: TestEntryResultCompletionCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling entry result completion.

classes.name: TestRangeResultCompletionCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling range result completion.

classes.name: MessageLoopHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing message loop and callback synchronization.

classes.name: CallbackTest
classes.description: Class for testing callback invocation and error handling.

methods.name: GenerateKey
methods.description: Generates a random key string, optionally of the same length.

methods.name: CacheTestFillBuffer
methods.description: Fills a buffer with random data, optionally avoiding null bytes.

methods.name: CreateCacheTestFile
methods.description: Creates a cache test file with a fixed size.

methods.name: CheckCacheIntegrity
methods.description: Checks the integrity of cache at a given path with specified parameters.

methods.name: callback
methods.description: Returns a callback bound to the class method for handling backend result.

methods.name: HelpSetResult
methods.description: Sets the result for range result callback.

methods.name: WaitUntilCacheIoFinished
methods.description: Waits until specified number of cache I/O callbacks are finished.

methods.name: TimerExpired
methods.description: Handles timer expiration to check callback completion.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Handles callback invocation, updating internal state and error checks.

methods.name: RunWithEntry
methods.description: Runs callback with a disk cache entry result.
